title: The leak scan's email shape catches an address at a dotless host and at an internationalised domain
goal: kbcommon.leak_hits reports kind email for an address at a dotless host such as localhost and at a domain with non-ASCII letters, so publish, redact and the tracked-file scan refuse them

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import kbcommon
cases = ["jan" + chr(64) + "localhost", "jan" + chr(64) + "münchen.de"]
miss = [c.split(chr(64))[1] for c in cases if not any(k == "email" for k, _ in kbcommon.leak_hits("x " + c + " y"))]
print("the leak scan misses an address at: " + ", ".join(miss) if miss else "ok"); sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)
